# Test fixtures

This folder (`$MY_PDF_PATH`, see `../common_paths.sh`) holds the PDF files used by the tests.
Only the small PDFs written by the author of the project are distributed with it; the other
files are third-party material that cannot be redistributed and are **optional**: a test
that needs a missing file is skipped (exit status 77), it does not fail.

| File / folder | Used by | Where to get it |
|---|---|---|
| Isartor test suite (`isartor-pdfa-2008-08-13/Isartor testsuite/`) | `test_isartor.sh` | <https://pdfa.org/resource/isartor-test-suite/> (download and unzip here) |
| PDF 2.0 examples (e.g. `pdf20-utf8-test.pdf`) | `test_regressioni_cjk.sh` | PDF Association, <https://pdfa.org/sponsored-standards/> (registration required; redistribution not allowed) |
| `Giapponesi/MistoJapanEnglish/{grammar_1,numbers,Kanji_Elementi}.pdf`, `Giapponesi/SoloGiapponese/H21 monodukuri report.pdf`, `kk190531a.pdf`, `leall_en_t.pdf`, `JapVertical_01.pdf` | `test_cmap_unicode.sh`, `test_regressioni_cjk.sh` | any Japanese PDFs with the same names (e.g. from the Internet Archive, <https://archive.org>) |
| Encrypted PDFs | `test_crypt_pdf_new.sh` | generated by `genera_pdf_cf.sh` into `generated/crypt` (needs `qpdf`) |
| Multilingual PDFs | `test_actualtext_multilingua.sh` | built from `latex/*.tex` by `latex/build_pdfs.sh` into `generated/latex` |

`test_ricerca_parziale.sh` works on any PDF found under this folder (recursively), or on `generated/latex` if there are none: the more
text it has, the better. Put some of your own PDFs here, or pass another folder as argument.
